scenes.text: This steak costs one hundred fifty nine pounds. Here's why.
It's a tomahawk from a steakhouse in Liverpool.
The same cut without gold costs thirty nine pounds.
The difference is twenty-four karat gold leaf, and it's completely edible.
The gold adds no flavor. You're paying for the look.
Would you pay a hundred and twenty pounds extra for gold? Follow for more jewelry on a plate.
